body:
Reviewed PR #13 ("plan: bind actual staged context at both trusted review callers") — an evidence-first, complete-input review of all 18 full-diff pages (145,295 bytes, 7 files).

**Deterministic gate:** clean. All 7 gates exit 0 (install, bootstrap_extensions, lint, test, generated_outputs_baseline, build, generated_outputs_restore); result=success, exact_head=true, clean_checkout=true, errors=[]. Lint: clj-kondo 0 errors/0 warnings across packages; tests: review-workflow 219/219 and other suites fail 0. No change-introduced failures; the bin-link ENOENT and informational layer-boundary lines are pre-existing environment noise, not defects.

**What this change is:** documentary/process only. Two new authentic evidence JSONs under .ημ/review-evidence/…/caller-redescription-20261013/ (a real GitHub review object for PR#12 and a DERIVED closeout/plan packet); append-only additions to .ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md, kanban/.events/ledger.edn, and receipts.edn; and a lawful kanban closeout on the spike card (establish-genuine…c164d16c) moving review→document→done with matching write-ids. The caller card (bind-and-verify…988cb996) stays status=incoming with only a re-description comment — no implementation claimed, consistent with its acceptance criterion that work awaits planning qualification. No executable source, dependency, authz, persistence-code, or deployment delta.

**Confirmed findings: none.** I audited the only behavioral contract in scope — append-only custody and FSM legality. The ledger/receipt diffs are pure appends with no rewrites; the FSM hops (review→document→done) are consecutive lawful states per the kanban FSM contract with no shortcut edges; both new JSONs carry internal hash/byte identities and are explicitly tiered as captured/DERIVED data rather than a synthesized approval; and the appended receipt's 7-file manifest matches the PR's changed-input list exactly.

**Non-blocking notes:** One low-confidence candidate (byte-unit consistency between the embedded REST body's "1,585,787 bytes" and the closeout packet's "1,628,770 bytes") was rejected on adversarial re-read — the figures are authentic captured data and this PR already reconciles the UTF16-geometry vs UTF8-source-byte distinction in its body, ledger, and packet. As expected for a planning/evidence PR, it introduces no new runtime code, so there are no executable branches requiring tests here; the RED/GREEN obligations it describes belong to the future caller-implementation work, correctly kept out of this change.

No invariant violations demonstrated. Approving.
